Verify Cryptographic Integrity and Zero-PII Invariants of an Audit Log

Source: R/audit.R
audit_log_verify.Rd

Recomputes the SHA-256 hash chain from GENESIS through the final entry in a JSONL audit log, verifying sequence continuity (1..n), prev_hash links, exact entry_hash digests, and absence of forbidden raw-text keys. Detects field edits, deletions, insertions, line reordering, and truncation.

Usage

audit_log_verify(path, strict = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character scalar path to the JSONL audit log file.

strict

Logical scalar; if TRUE (default), also verifies that all top-level fields belong to the strict v1.0 audit schema allowlist.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_audit_verification" with elements valid, n_entries, first_invalid_seq, chain_head_hash, issues, and verified_at.

Examples

tmp_log <- tempfile(fileext = ".jsonl")
pf <- preflight_isolation_check(endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
audit_log_append(tmp_log, pf)
#> <airgap_audit_entry> #1 [preflight_check]
#>   Run ID:       preflight_20261124T214320Z_85aa3ed8
#>   Timestamp:    2026-11-24T21:43:20Z
#>   Isolation:    PASS
#>   PII policy:   NA
#>   Prev hash:    GENESIS
#>   Entry hash:   sha256:f032df3490e2153f75621fdb7d6621e611153458e2c6751e0493f9b2fbc5c52c
audit_log_verify(tmp_log)
#> <airgap_audit_verification> [VALID]
#>   Entries verified: 1
#>   Chain head hash:  sha256:f032df3490e2153f75621fdb7d6621e611153458e2c6751e0493f9b2fbc5c52c
unlink(tmp_log)
